goal.title: JEE Main & Advanced
goal.tagline: Comprehensive Master Plan for Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics Mastery
goal.description: Official NTA & IIT JEE Advanced syllabus coverage with deep conceptual rigor, formula derivation, Physics Galaxy illustrations, NCERT Chemistry foundations, MathonGo PYQ drills, and JoSAA admission guidance.
targetRoles: Top 1% All India Rank in JEE Main & Advanced
Admissions to IITs, NITs, IIITs & BITS
B.Tech in Computer Science / Electrical / Core Engineering

careerPath.title: Stage 1: Core Conceptual Foundations & NCERT Mastery
careerPath.subtitle: Class 11 & 12 Fundamentals Across PCM
careerPath.description: Build rigorous foundational concepts in Mechanics, Physical Chemistry, and Algebra. Ensure zero conceptual gaps using NCERT and standard theory.
milestones: Complete all NCERT textbook reading and in-text problems in Chemistry
Derive every fundamental law in Physics (Kinematics, Newton's Laws, Work-Energy)
Maintain a dedicated Formula & Theorem Notebook for daily revision

careerPath.title: Stage 2: Standard Problem Solving & JEE Main Mastery
careerPath.subtitle: Speed, Accuracy & Chapter-wise PYQ Drills
careerPath.description: Develop numerical dexterity and quick dimensional/elimination techniques required to crack JEE Main with 99+ percentile.
milestones: Solve 10+ years of chapter-wise JEE Main Previous Year Questions (PYQs)
Practice timed 60-minute sectional problem sets for speed and accuracy
Identify and eliminate repeated negative marking errors

careerPath.title: Stage 3: Advanced Problem Solving & Multi-Concept Drills
careerPath.subtitle: JEE Advanced Depth, Mixed Concepts & Rigorous Analysis
careerPath.description: Tackle multi-concept, multi-correct, comprehension, and matrix-match questions designed for JEE Advanced rank maximization.
milestones: Complete Physics Galaxy Advanced Illustrations and challenging problems
Solve 15 years of JEE Advanced subjective and objective PYQs
Master multi-chapter synthesis (e.g. Calculus in Mechanics, Thermodynamics in Physical Chemistry)

careerPath.title: Stage 4: National Exam Simulation & CBT Conditioning
careerPath.subtitle: Full 3-Hour Computer Based Tests & Error Log Auditing
careerPath.description: Simulate real exam conditions (Paper 1 & Paper 2) to build mental stamina, exam temperament, and time allocation strategy.
milestones: Complete 20+ full-length 3-hour Computer Based Mock Tests (CBTs)
Maintain an Error Logbook: categorize errors into silly mistakes, conceptual gaps, or time pressure
Achieve consistent 99+ percentile performance across mock series

careerPath.title: Stage 5: JoSAA Counselling, Seat Allocation & College Enrollment
careerPath.subtitle: Official JoSAA / CSAB Strategy, Choice Filling & Institute Selection
careerPath.description: Navigate the official Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA) process, rank analytics, choice prioritization, and document verification.
milestones: Analyze opening and closing ranks for IITs, NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs across prior years
Lock optimal prioritized choice order based on genuine branch interest and institute tier
Complete seat acceptance, fee payment, and physical reporting at the allocated institute
